import LindenstraussPolynomials.Deficit

Control of ordered compositions

Iterating the deficit identity controls the deficits along ordered compositions of substitutions (eq:vbase, eq:vcompositions), with a bound (7K_n)^d\alpha_{i_1} and a scalar that does not depend on the parameters t_i — which is what Lemma lem:geometry needs.
